name: tkbot
description: TK$ Bot - Bot multipropósito para Discord con panel de control web

scripts.web: npm run sync:env && npm run dev --workspace @tkbot/web
scripts.build: npm run sync:env && npm run build --workspace @tkbot/web
scripts.start:web: npm run sync:env && npm run start --workspace @tkbot/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @tkbot/bot && npm run test --workspace @tkbot/web
